end.summary:
Practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers in words and numerals.
Practised place value in 2450, including thousands and hundreds places.
Practised numbers with internal zeros and expanded form.
Diya wrote 4050 for “four thousand fifty.”
The zero-placeholder mix-up was seen and not corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value charts, number names, and numbers with zeros inside them. Diya correctly wrote 4050 for “four thousand fifty” after considering the thousands place. They mixed up how to represent empty places and how to combine tens and ones; this was not corrected by the end. At home, practise building numbers such as 3,042 and 5,070 with place-value cards, keeping a zero in each empty place.
